description: A zoo needs to transport their monkeys to the vet either by bus or by car. A bus can transport 20 monkeys per trip and takes 30 minutes. A car can transport 6 monkeys per trip and takes 15 minutes. There can be at most 10 bus trips. In addition, since the monkeys get aggressive when there are too many in one place at least 60% of the trips should be by car. If the zoo needs to transport 300 monkeys, how many trips of each should be done to minimize the total time required to transport the monkeys?

BusCapacity.definition: Number of monkeys a bus can transport per trip

BusTripTime.definition: Time in minutes a bus takes per trip

CarCapacity.definition: Number of monkeys a car can transport per trip

CarTripTime.definition: Time in minutes a car takes per trip

MaxBusTrips.definition: Maximum number of bus trips allowed

MinCarTripFraction.definition: Minimum fraction of trips that must be by car

objective.description: "Minimize the total time required to transport all 300 monkeys to the vet"

constraints.description: BusTrips and CarTrips must be integers

BusTrips.definition: Number of trips made by bus

CarTrips.definition: Number of trips made by car
